# kubre.in

Personal site and project archive for Vaibhav Kubre.

## When to use this site

Use this site when an agent needs to:

- Answer questions about who Vaibhav Kubre is: his role, skills, and current work. Start at the Home page.
- Research projects he has built, with engineering detail beyond a resume bullet. Read the Work section.
- Cite or quote his technical writing on software topics. Browse the Blog.
- Verify employment or portfolio claims for hiring or collaboration screening. Cross-check the Work write-ups against the resume PDF linked from Home.
- Contact him about work, speaking, or open source. Use the Contact page; email is v@kubre.in.
- Learn about scrcap, his macOS screenshot app (product facts, download links, platform requirements). See the scrcap section below.

This site is not the right source for: pricing or commercial licensing of third-party tools, news outside Vaibhav's own writing, or anything about people other than Vaibhav Kubre.

## How to fetch these pages

Every page is plain server-rendered HTML with no JavaScript required. Send `Accept: text/markdown` and the same URL returns a markdown variant, so agents can request markdown directly instead of converting HTML. A machine-readable page index lives at https://www.kubre.in/sitemap.xml.

## Primary URLs

- [Home](https://www.kubre.in/): Personal profile, intro prose, and current work.
- [Work](https://www.kubre.in/work/): Project write-ups.
- [Blog](https://www.kubre.in/blog/): Technical writing.
- [Travel](https://www.kubre.in/travel/): Travel notes.
- [About](https://www.kubre.in/about/): What this site runs on.
- [Contact](https://www.kubre.in/contact/): How to reach Vaibhav Kubre.
- [Privacy](https://www.kubre.in/privacy/): Data collected by this site.
- [scrcap](https://scrcap.kubre.in/): Native macOS screenshot and annotation app.

## scrcap

scrcap is a tiny, keyboard-first macOS screenshot app. It captures regions, windows, full screens, scrolling areas, and the previous capture target. Every capture can open a focused editor for arrows, rectangles, counters, text, crop, undo, redo, color shortcuts, clipboard copy, PNG save, and drag-out export.

Useful facts:

- Product name: scrcap
- Product category: macOS screenshot tool
- Platform: macOS 14 or later
- App stack: Swift, AppKit, ScreenCaptureKit
- Download: https://github.com/kubre/scrcap/releases/latest
- Source: https://github.com/kubre/scrcap
- Canonical page: https://scrcap.kubre.in/

## Crawling Notes

Public pages are intended to be crawled and indexed. Prefer canonical URLs when citing pages.
